The loop scores each commit against one diff only, so nothing checks whether COMMIT 3's prop surfaces actually fit what COMMIT 4 will hand them. That is your job. Read it with: `git -C /Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa show sfcc-89-wip:overrides/app/pages/product-detail/index.tsx` (if that ref does not exist, run `git -C ... branch -a` and `git -C ... log --oneline --all | head -40` to find the equivalent WIP ref, and say which you used). VERIFY THESE, PREFERRING AN EXPERIMENT OVER A READING: 1. **Explicit `undefined` through the optional chain.** COMMIT 4 is expected to pass `price={isProductPartOfBundle ? undefined : info.price}` into `ZimmProductContent`. COMMIT 3 widened `price: string` -> `price?: string` on BOTH `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmProductContent/index.tsx` and `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmProductPrice/index.tsx`. - Confirm `tsconfig.json` has no `exactOptionalPropertyTypes` (check the file AND any `extends` chain, and check `node_modules/@salesforce/pwa-kit-dev`-provided base configs if extended). - Then PROVE it: in your own /tmp copy, write a scratch `.tsx` that passes an explicit `undefined` (and a `string | undefined` union, and a ternary producing `undefined`) into `ZimmProductContent` and into `ZimmProductPrice`, and run `npx tsc --noEmit` from that copy's root. Report the exact result. Also prove the negative: does passing `undefined` to a prop that is NOT optional error, so you know tsc is actually checking your scratch file? - Does the runtime guard `if (!price) return null` in zimmProductPrice/index.tsx handle `undefined` as well as `''`? Note any value where `!price` is true but rendering nothing would be WRONG (e.g. `'0'`? `0`?). 2. **`ZimmProductMeta`'s prop surface vs what the page will pass.** New file `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmProductMeta/index.tsx` declares `{ modelInfo?: string; styleCode?: string }` and guards with `if (isBlankRichText(modelInfo) && !styleCode) return null;`. - From the `sfcc-89-wip` version of `pages/product-detail/index.tsx`, find `renderStaticProductHeader` (or whatever renders the meta block) and extract the EXACT shape/field names/types it passes for model info and style code. Does it pass `modelInfo`/`styleCode`, or different names? Does it pass the atoms directly rather than a molecule (in which case what would need to change)? - Read `overrides/app/pages/product-detail/productInfo.ts` (`selectPdpProductInfo` and the `PdpProductInfo` type) on the CURRENT working tree. What does the mapper actually produce for the model-info and style-code fields — `string`, `string | undefined`, `''`? Does `ZimmProductMeta`'s prop surface accept the mapper's output directly with no adaptation? PROVE with a scratch tsc file that passes a real `PdpProductInfo` value's fields in. - Is the guard's predicate CONSISTENT with what the page supplies? Specifically: the mapper may normalise absent values to `''`. `isBlankRichText('')` — what does it return (read `overrides/app/utils/richText.tsx`)? And what about a value the mapper leaves as raw HTML like `'

'`? Is there any input the mapper can produce where the molecule renders an empty padded box, or conversely hides content that exists? - Check the atom `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmProductStyleCode/index.tsx`: is its `value` prop optional? If `styleCode` is `string | undefined` and `value` is required, that is a tsc error — verify by compiling, not reading. 3. **Did widening `ZimmProductContent`'s `price` break existing consumers/stories?** - `grep -rn "ZimmProductContent" /Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides` and check every consumer. - Read `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmProductContent/index.stories.tsx` in full. Do the three pre-existing stories still typecheck and behave the same? Does any of them now silently exercise the new null-return branch (e.g. a story that passes `price: ''` or omits it and previously rendered an empty node whose presence a `play` asserted)? Check whether any existing `play` asserts something about `product-price` or about a computed gap/child-count that the 4a change alters. - `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmProductPrice/index.stories.tsx` — does it have a story that passes an empty/absent price and would now render nothing (a blank story canvas is a real reviewer trap)? REPORTING RULES: - Every finding needs `absolute/file/path:line` PLUS the anchor text of that line (line numbers drift; a bare number is unusable). - Label each finding CONFIRMED (you reproduced it) or PLAUSIBLE (reasoned only). - Severity BLOCKER / DEFECT / NOTE. - Falsify, don't confirm. If you claim something works, say what experiment you ran and paste the decisive output. - Do NOT write any report/summary .md file. Return findings as your final message text. - End with a section headed exactly `What I could not verify` naming what you could not reach and why.

Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Here are the findings. ## Premise corrections (both matter for the caller) The WIP ref I used is **`sfcc-89-wip`** (commit `3ae8dcd` "chore: wip SFCC-89 static product info restore point"), branched off `8362b3c`. Two of the task's stated premises do not match what's actually on that ref: 1. **COMMIT 4 does not use the ternary.** `/tmp/wip_pdp.tsx` ← `sfcc-89-wip:overrides/app/pages/product-detail/index.tsx:730` — anchor ``. `isProductPartOfBundle` *is* destructured (`:713`, anchor `isProductPartOfBundle,`) but only gates the PromoCallout (`:734`, anchor `{!isProductPartOfBundle && (`). No `undefined` ternary reaches `price`. 2. **COMMIT 4 does not use `ZimmProductMeta` at all** — the molecule does not exist on that ref. The page renders the two atoms directly: `:882` anchor `` and `:883` anchor ``, wrapped in `:881` anchor ``. --- ## 1. Explicit `undefined` through the optional chain — CONFIRMED SAFE (NOTE) `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/tsconfig.json` — no `exactOptionalPropertyTypes`, and **no `extends` key at all** (grep returned nothing); `find` confirms it is the only `tsconfig*.json` outside `node_modules`, so there is no base config from `@salesforce/pwa-kit-dev` in play. **Experiment.** In `/tmp/c3probe/xfit` I wrote `overrides/app/__xfit_pos.tsx` passing (a) literal `undefined`, (b) a `string | undefined` union, and (c) the exact premise ternary `isBundle ? undefined : info.price` into both `ZimmProductContent` and `ZimmProductPrice`, plus mapper output into `ZimmProductMeta`/`ZimmProductStyleCode`/`ZimmProductModelInfo`. Result: `TSC_EXIT=0`, zero diagnostics. **Negative control (proves tsc was reading the scratch file):** `overrides/app/__xfit_neg.tsx` passing `undefined` to non-optional props produced `TSC_EXIT=2` and exactly 4 errors: ``` overrides/app/__xfit_neg.tsx(8,45): error TS2322: Type 'undefined' is not assignable to type 'string'. overrides/app/__xfit_neg.tsx(10,54): error TS2322: Type 'undefined' is not assignable to type '"h1" | "h2" | "h3"'. overrides/app/__xfit_neg.tsx(12,51): error TS2322: Type 'undefined' is not assignable to type '"h1" | "h2" | "h3"'. overrides/app/__xfit_neg.tsx(14,45): error TS2322: Type 'string | undefined' is not assignable to type 'string'. ``` **Decisive cross-commit experiment.** Copied `sfcc-89-wip`'s page onto COMMIT 3's working-tree components → `TSC_EXIT=0`. Then mutated it into the *expected* COMMIT 4 shape (`price={isProductPartOfBundle ? undefined : info.price}` **and** the atoms swapped for ``) → `TSC_EXIT=0`, zero diagnostics. **The prop surfaces fit; there is no type-level cross-commit break.** ### Runtime guard `if (!price) return null` — CONFIRMED correct, no wrongly-hidden value `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmProductPrice/index.tsx:35` — anchor `if (!price) return null;`. Rendered a matrix through real jsdom: ``` PRICE | "" | rendered=false PRICE | "0" | rendered=true text="0" PRICE | "0.00" | rendered=true text="0.00" PRICE | "$0.00" | rendered=true text="$0.00" PRICE | " " | rendered=true text=" " PRICE | "$NaN" | rendered=true text="$NaN" ``` `price` is typed `string`, so numeric `0` is unreachable (the negative control shows tsc enforces this). `'0'`/`'0.00'`/`'$0.00'` all render — **there is no value where `!price` is true but hiding is wrong.** My hypothesis that a zero price would be wrongly hidden is **falsified**. --- ## 2. `ZimmProductMeta` prop surface vs what the page will pass ### 2a. BLOCKER-adjacent — `ZimmProductMeta` has zero consumers (CONFIRMED, DEFECT) `grep -rn "ZimmProductMeta" overrides/` returns only its own folder plus one registration: `overrides/app/theme/components/index.ts:38` — anchor `ZimmProductMeta,`. COMMIT 4 as it exists on `sfcc-89-wip` renders the two atoms directly and **will not pick the molecule up**. So COMMIT 3 ships a molecule + recipe + 4-case Vitest suite + Storybook `play` that nothing renders, and COMMIT 4 must be *edited* beyond a restore to consume it. The loop scores each commit alone, so neither diff surfaces this. ### 2b. Field names and types line up exactly (CONFIRMED) `overrides/app/pages/product-detail/productInfo.ts:33-39` — anchor `export type PdpProductInfo = {` — produces `modelInfo?: string` (`:60`, anchor `modelInfo: product.c_modelFit,`) and `styleCode?: string` (`:64`, anchor `styleCode: product.master?.masterId ?? product.id,`). `ZimmProductMeta`'s props (`overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmProductMeta/index.tsx:14` anchor `modelInfo?: string;`, `:19` anchor `styleCode?: string;`) match name-for-name and type-for-type. No adaptation needed — proven by the tsc run above. The new branch **is** covered at both layers: the `WithoutPrice` story above, plus a new untracked Vitest file `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmProductPrice/index.test.tsx:24` — anchor `test.each([undefined, ''])('renders nothing for %s', (price) => {`. **No blank-canvas trap in the price atom's stories.** `git diff sfcc-89-wip -- .../zimmProductPrice/index.stories.tsx` is empty (unchanged), and both stories pass truthy values: `:20` anchor `args: { price: '$795.00' },` and `:29-32` anchors `` … ``. Nothing renders an empty canvas. Full suite on the clean copy: **24 files / 362 tests, all passing.** --- ## Two further cross-commit findings the per-diff loop cannot see ### A. Double top-padding if COMMIT 4 swaps the molecule into the existing Stack (CONFIRMED values, PLAUSIBLE trigger) `sfcc-89-wip:.../product-detail/index.tsx:881` — anchor ``. `overrides/app/theme/foundation/spacing.ts:14` — anchor `l: '1.25rem', // 20px`. The molecule's own recipe adds its own: `.../zimmProductMeta/zimmProductMeta.css.ts:22` anchor `const SPACE_META_ROW = '1.75rem'; // 28px at the default 16px root`, applied at `:35` anchor `paddingTop: SPACE_META_ROW, // drawers -> model line`. The two sit on different elements, so a naive swap that keeps the `Stack` yields **20px + 28px = 48px** against a design that specifies 28px — and the molecule's `play` (`.../zimmProductMeta/index.stories.tsx:53`, anchor `await expect(getComputedStyle(root).paddingTop).toBe('28px');`) measures the molecule in isolation and would still pass. The `Stack` must be deleted, not repopulated. ### B. The `typeof === 'number'` price guard admits `NaN` and `Infinity` (CONFIRMED behaviour, unproven reachability, NOTE) `productInfo.ts:58` — anchor `price: typeof priceData?.currentPrice === 'number' ? formatPrice(priceData.currentPrice, currency) : '',`. Since `typeof NaN === 'number'`: ``` MAPPER | currentPrice=undefined | price="" renders=false MAPPER | currentPrice=null | price="" renders=false MAPPER | currentPrice=NaN | price="$NaN" renders=true MAPPER | currentPrice=Infinity | price="$∞" renders=true MAPPER | currentPrice=0 | price="$0.00" renders=true ``` This falsifies two in-repo claims written by COMMIT 3: - `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmProductPrice/index.tsx:12` — anchor `* Optional because the page's mapper resolves an absent price to `''` rather than to a` … "formatted `NaN`". It resolves a *missing* price to `''`; it does not stop a formatted `NaN`. - `overrides/app/pages/product-detail/productInfo.test.ts:70` — anchor `test('an absent price renders empty rather than "NaN" or "undefined"', () => {`. The three assertions under it cover `null`, `{}`, and `{currentPrice: undefined}` only — **never an actual `NaN`**, despite the title. Reachability: base `getPriceData` (`node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/utils/product-utils.js`) sets `currentPrice = findLowestPrice(product)?.minPrice` straight from the API, so I could **not** demonstrate a path that makes it `NaN` (a string `minPrice` fails `typeof` and correctly yields `''`). Treat this as a latent guard gap plus two overclaiming comments, not a live shopper-facing bug. `Number.isFinite` would close it. ### C. Minor divergence from the base header for a zero price (CONFIRMED, NOTE) `overrides/app/components/product-view/index.tsx:216-217` — anchors `` and `{priceData?.currentPrice && }`. The base header hid a `currentPrice` of `0` (falsy). The new path formats it and renders `"$0.00"`. Arguably a fix, but it is a behaviour change relative to the base component that the copy-first/minimal-changes rule would want called out.
